seattle-pacific-northwest-mount-st-helen.story: A proper escape from Seattle with roads worth waking up for. A 694 km loop that starts and ends near Bonney Lake, about 14 h 28 of riding. The climbs: near Tanglewilde-Thompson Place, Scenic stretch near Seabeck and near Sequim. It tops out at about 1,600 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 48 km. 607 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Route des Grandes Alpes
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1607 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

route-des-grandes-alpes-col-de-vars-ment.story: A 201 km one-way ride from near Embrun, about 3 h 18 of riding. The stops in between: Col de la Bonette and Col de Turini. The highest point is about 2,700 m. Col de Vars, Col de Restefond and Col de Turini are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Aschaffenburg → Lohr am Main
scenicChapters.narrative: Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through. 30 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it.
